description: A dead reactor room: evenly spaced rod-column husks around a central vessel, floor cracked with slag, one dead glow marker per column. 22x12px.
notes: Shape grammar (evenly spaced vertical rod columns + a central vessel) copied from the community RBMK saves (2001108 etc.) and from 370469's 'Chernobyl Disaster' wrecked-core diorama technique -- static and cold (no reaction), the silhouette alone reads as 'reactor'.
